globalStyle.voice: @me verified avatar voice (identical pitch, tone, accent in every clip)
globalStyle.outfit: crisp white shirt and black blazer (identical in every scene)
globalStyle.background: solid plain seamless mid-grey studio background, soft even lighting; subtle semi-transparent 3D motion graphics float ONLY behind the avatar's shoulders and in the empty space to the left and right, always at the same two positions and size in every scene
globalStyle.gestures: Standing still in the same spot, natural calm hand gestures kept below chest level
globalStyle.audio: @me verified avatar voice ONLY, continuous speech filling the full 10 seconds at a brisk explainer pace, NO background music, NO silence at start or end
globalStyle.negativePrompts: Avatar stays centered in the foreground with face and body fully visible at all times; NO visual ever overlaps or covers the face, hands or body; NO text on screen, NO captions, NO name tags, NO logos, NO words inside the visuals, NO scales of justice, NO outfit change, NO camera cut, NO tripod, NO camera or microphone or any studio equipment visible in frame, nothing in front of the avatar
globalStyle.camera: Locked-off static shot, medium close-up framed from chest up, avatar centered in frame at the same size in every scene, eye level, 50mm lens look, no zoom, no pan, no camera movement; the camera itself is never visible
globalStyle.realism: Photorealistic live-action footage of a real human presenter recorded in one studio session, natural skin texture, natural eye contact and accurate lip sync, soft even key light from the front, identical exposure and white balance in every scene
globalStyle.delivery: Energetic educational explainer style, like a confident teacher: brisk pace, continuous speech, no long pauses, natural emphasis on key words; speak the dialogue exactly once, word for word, never repeat, stretch or slow down a word

scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ravi from LawWorld. You buy a flat trusting the brochure, the wide roads, the open spaces. What if half of it never gets built? The apex court has answered.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip. Left anchor: a translucent 3D property brochure slowly opening. Right anchor: a large 3D question mark rotating gently. The 3D elements sit at the two fixed anchor positions (behind the left shoulder and behind the right shoulder), same size and depth as every other scene, softly lit, semi-transparent, never in front of the face, hands or body.

scenes.dialogue: Imagine a developer launches a housing project. The layout shows a wide road running through the site. Buyers pay a premium price trusting that plan, expecting their homes to be handed over.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip. Left anchor: a 3D apartment tower rising from a small base plate. Right anchor: a 3D site plan sheet with a wide road drawn across it. The 3D elements sit at the two fixed anchor positions (behind the left shoulder and behind the right shoulder), same size and depth as every other scene, softly lit, semi-transparent, never in front of the face, hands or body.

scenes.dialogue: A decade later, homebuyers told the court that road simply does not exist as shown. A long stretch meant to be a road had quietly become landscaping and parking instead.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip. Left anchor: a 3D road strip that fades out halfway along its length. Right anchor: a 3D cluster of small trees and a parked car icon. The 3D elements sit at the two fixed anchor positions (behind the left shoulder and behind the right shoulder), same size and depth as every other scene, softly lit, semi-transparent, never in front of the face, hands or body.

scenes.dialogue: Consumer complaints went first to the national commission, then all the way to the apex court. The court ordered a central agency to hold a preliminary enquiry into the whole project.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip. Left anchor: a 3D stack of complaint files rising step by step. Right anchor: a 3D magnifying glass hovering over a sealed folder. The 3D elements sit at the two fixed anchor positions (behind the left shoulder and behind the right shoulder), same size and depth as every other scene, softly lit, semi-transparent, never in front of the face, hands or body.

scenes.dialogue: When the agency filed its status report, the bench was clear: this deviation was not minor. It was substantial, and it struck at the very heart of what buyers were promised.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip. Left anchor: a 3D report document with a red flag marker. Right anchor: a 3D balance tilting sharply to one side. The 3D elements sit at the two fixed anchor positions (behind the left shoulder and behind the right shoulder), same size and depth as every other scene, softly lit, semi-transparent, never in front of the face, hands or body.

scenes.dialogue: The principle laid down is simple and powerful. A housing project must be delivered exactly in accordance with what was represented to buyers through the brochure and the sanctioned plan.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip. Left anchor: a 3D brochure page. Right anchor: a 3D finished building that matches the brochure page exactly, with a bright equals sign glowing between them. The 3D elements sit at the two fixed anchor positions (behind the left shoulder and behind the right shoulder), same size and depth as every other scene, softly lit, semi-transparent, never in front of the face, hands or body.

scenes.dialogue: To speed things up, the court directed the agency to assign two additional inspectors to the enquiry. Then the bench turned to the developer with a sharp and direct warning.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip. Left anchor: two 3D inspector badge icons appearing one after the other. Right anchor: a 3D stopwatch ticking forward. The 3D elements sit at the two fixed anchor positions (behind the left shoulder and behind the right shoulder), same size and depth as every other scene, softly lit, semi-transparent, never in front of the face, hands or body.

scenes.dialogue: Complete the project in all respects, exactly as per the brochure, before the next date of hearing. Otherwise, the court made clear, it will take serious action against the developer.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip. Left anchor: a 3D calendar page with a circled deadline date. Right anchor: a 3D warning triangle pulsing softly. The 3D elements sit at the two fixed anchor positions (behind the left shoulder and behind the right shoulder), same size and depth as every other scene, softly lit, semi-transparent, never in front of the face, hands or body.

scenes.dialogue: So a brochure is no longer just marketing. It is a representation the builder can be held to in court. Follow LawWorld for the rulings that change how you buy and build!
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip. Left anchor: a 3D brochure transforming into a formal sealed document. Right anchor: a 3D rotating check mark beside a subtle follow-arrow icon. The 3D elements sit at the two fixed anchor positions (behind the left shoulder and behind the right shoulder), same size and depth as every other scene, softly lit, semi-transparent, never in front of the face, hands or body.
